scripts.//predev: D-049. The Prisma client is generated, not committed, so pulling a branch that adds a MODEL leaves a client with no delegate for it and the route 500s with `Cannot read properties of undefined`. postinstall covers a fresh install and covered nothing else. This runs BEFORE the watcher starts, which is also the only order that works on Windows: tsx holds the query-engine DLL open and `prisma generate` fails on the file lock while the dev server is running.
scripts.//db:migrate: N-013, and 03 §5 has said `migrate deploy`, never `migrate dev` since the suite was written — this script said `dev` anyway until 2026-08-31, when it bit. MIGRATIONS ARE HAND-WRITTEN HERE. schema.prisma cannot express the CHECK constraints, partial and GIN indexes, the DEFERRABLE unique on questions(template_id, position), the anonymity trigger, or the `sessions` table connect-pg-simple owns (DEC-014), so the database is PERMANENTLY drifted from it by design. `migrate dev` diffs the two and offers to "fix" the difference: the migration it generated dropped all four of those objects and the sessions table with them. It failed on one DROP INDEX by luck — Postgres refuses to drop an index a constraint needs — and N-013 is precisely the note saying that had it succeeded, the app would still have run. Author migrations by hand and apply them with this.
